from_speaker: it would be much much harder to do with images
our_interpretation: In context, 'the image generation programs' means the deployed products discussed in Marcus and Southen's investigation, particularly Midjourney and DALL-E 3. It does not mean every research prototype.
'It' refers to retrieval-augmented generation: retrieving external material to condition generation. Training on images or accepting user-supplied reference images does not alone establish RAG.
'So far' describes product use through 2024-01-08. No starting date is supplied, so the historical interval has an unspecified start.

The difficulty comparison concerns adding retrieval augmentation to image generation versus text generation using methods available by that date. 'Much much harder' means substantially greater practical implementation difficulty; no numerical threshold is added.
The difficulty clause is a technical comparison at publication, not a forecast with a future deadline.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable records establish non-use of RAG in the relevant deployed product versions through the post date, and comparable technical evidence establishes substantially greater implementation difficulty for image RAG than text RAG.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that a relevant deployed product version used RAG by the post date, or a comparable technical assessment establishes that image RAG did not entail substantially greater implementation difficulty. Research prototypes alone do not contradict product non-use.
